controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-12T20:06:42.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:06:42.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        distinct_users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name),
        distinct_sources = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
